_about: How LTEC holds a deal. A template builds the deal's warehouse (vehicle) inputs from the deal's check (investor.check) and the vehicle close date, with LTEC's partners. Applied by apply_structure (core.py) / applyStructure (core.js), or scripts/apply_structure.py. Amounts in a template are fractions of the check (reserve_pct, manager_commitment_pct); everything else is copied. Defaults follow SV26 (Siena, Nov 3 memo) as LTEC's precedent; change them here to change the house terms. A template's note may use {manager} and any of its own numbers ({sale_carry}, {promote}, ...), filled by template_note / templateNote.

direct.label: Direct: LTEC invests
direct.note: {manager} itself writes the check into the deal. No SPV, no SPV fees or promote. {manager}'s partners own {manager} by their capital, and {manager}'s terms between its partners apply.

spv.label: SPV, fully subscribed
spv.note: An SPV invests the check with a {reserve_pct} reserve; {manager} commits {manager_commitment_pct} of the check and manages it, outside members put in the rest at close. {manager} earns a {acq_fee_pct} acquisition fee and {promote} of profits above the members' {member_hurdle_irr} hurdle.

spv_warehouse.label: SPV with warehouse & sell-down (SV26-style)
spv_warehouse.note: As the fully subscribed SPV ({reserve_pct} reserve, {manager} commits {manager_commitment_pct}, {acq_fee_pct} acquisition fee, {promote} promote over {member_hurdle_irr}), but the lead partner funds the outside share at close (warehouses it) and sells it to new members {sale_months} months later at par plus {sale_carry} simple carry.
